row.evidence: Hugging Face's pricing page lists 'Automated user management with SCIM provisioning' under Enterprise ($50/month per user, Talk to sales), not under Team ($20/month per user, which has SAML and OIDC SSO).
row.notes: New row. SCIM is Enterprise-only, in two forms: on Enterprise ($50/user/mo, 'from' price, Talk to sales) with Basic SSO it is invitation-based (users need an existing Hugging Face account, receive an invite and must accept; SCIM cannot change their profile), and full-lifecycle SCIM (account creation, profile updates, deactivation) needs Managed SSO on Enterprise Plus (custom price, managed organization set up with Hugging Face). SAML/OIDC Basic SSO is on Team ($20/user/mo). The pricing page does not say whether prices are monthly or annual; the docs plan table repeats 20$/user/Mo and from 50$/user/Mo. SCIM 2.0 endpoints are in the public OpenAPI spec (/api/organizations/{name}/scim/v2 for managed orgs, /scim-provisioning/v2 for invitation-based). Okta and Entra are configured with the tenant URL and bearer token on the vendor's own app; the Okta OIN app is SAML-only. SCIM DELETE on Managed SSO permanently deletes the account and its content. Org members, roles, resource groups and audit-log export are in the Hub API; audit logs are Team and up.

auth.token_source: Organization settings > SSO > SCIM sub-tab > Generate an access token (shown once)

deprovision.data_retained: active=false: removed from the org, account and content kept (Managed SSO, reversible) or invitation deactivated (Basic SSO). DELETE: Basic SSO removes membership only; Managed SSO permanently deletes the account and all its content.

attributes.notes: With Basic SSO only active and externalId are writable; the others are read-only.

roles.how: Link a SCIM group to one or more Resource Groups, each with its own role; org-level roles come from SSO role mapping (admin, write, contributor, read).

limitations.text: On Enterprise (Basic SSO) SCIM only invites users who already have a Hugging Face account; they must accept the invite, and SCIM cannot change their name, email or username.
Full-lifecycle SCIM requires a managed organization (Enterprise Plus), converted by the Hugging Face account team.
PATCH does not support complex path filters such as emails[type eq 'work'].value; remove works only for externalId.
Usernames must be 2-42 characters, regular characters and '-' only, and unique within the org.
Resource Groups linked to a SCIM group block manual membership changes for regular users (403).
Okta cannot use the same group for app assignment and Group Push.

auth.notes: Scopes not documented in the sections reviewed.

capabilities.notes: Outside SCIM, no endpoint to invite or remove org members was found in the OpenAPI spec.

endpoints.purpose: Change user role in resource group

rate_limits.text: API requests per period: Free 1,000, Team 3,000, Enterprise 6,000, Enterprise Plus 10,000 up to 100,000.

okta.notes: OIN page checks SAML only. Hugging Face's own guide enables SCIM on the Hugging Face app in Okta with the tenant URL and bearer token, so idp.okta is via_generic.

entra.notes: learn.microsoft.com hugging-face-tutorial returns 404; Hugging Face documents Entra provisioning with Tenant URL and Secret Token.

google.notes: Google Workspace SSO guides (SAML and OIDC) exist; no Google provisioning documented.

fallbacks.other_sync: Basic SSO join link (manual), SSO role mapping and resource-group mapping
